name: Raw Browser
description: Drives the Chrome or Edge you are already signed into through the Raw Browser 0.6.2 bridge: 16 tools for tabs, navigation, reading, clicking, filling, screenshots and cookies. Read-only tools inherit normal policy; navigation, input, visits and cookie reads are reviewed; raw_eval and the raw_call escape hatch are blocked. Install with npm install -g raw-browser; the raw-mcp command starts the server. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Prefer raw_status, raw_tabs, raw_text, raw_html, raw_snapshot, raw_screenshot and raw_frames; they read the current tab without changing it.
raw_eval and raw_call are blocked: they run arbitrary page JavaScript or any Raw.* / CDP method. Use the typed tool that performs the same action.
raw_cookies returns live session cookies. Use a browser profile dedicated to the agent and never send cookie values to a model, another service, or a file that syncs.
raw_click, raw_fill, raw_goto, raw_new and raw_visit can submit forms, start purchases, or carry data in a URL. Read every argument before approving.
The bridge listens only on 127.0.0.1 and requires the per-browser token; keep the token local and do not expose the port.
